ai_no_adapter: The adapter does not answer the assistant. Update the adapter and restart the instance.
ai_no_answer: The provider did not answer in time.
ai_no_key: No AI provider is configured. Enter a key in the settings of the instance.
ai_no_models: The provider offered no models. Check the key and, for an endpoint of your own, the address.
ai_too_many_steps: The assistant took too many steps without finishing. Tell it how to continue.
ai_truncated: The answer was cut off: the model used up its output budget.
